meta.name: inner-ally
meta.description: Deeply personal mentor and guide. Use when struggling, wanting to quit, feeling overwhelmed, or doubting yourself. Empathy-first. Build this skill around YOUR psychology.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提供贴心陪伴，在你自我怀疑与想放弃时帮你重拾信心
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常因压力想放弃或陷入自我怀疑
copy.tagline_en: Provide empathetic support when you doubt yourself and feel like giving up.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often feel overwhelmed and want to quit.

howto.what: 配置个人心理档案后,Claude 会作为了解你本人的私人导师,依据档案中的人格张力、放弃模式与干预方式,共情优先地回应,并遵守你的响应规则。
howto.when: 当你陷入挣扎、想放弃或自我怀疑等状态时触发。

say.text: 我卡在这个 bug 上两小时了,既想继续又想放弃。
say.note: 触发技能,按你的档案回应。

say.text: 我有点自我怀疑,觉得这项目没意义。
say.note: 技能会结合你的放弃模式来回应。

say.text: 我感觉自己撑不下去了,什么都做不好。
say.note: 技能会先接纳情绪,再按你的规则给帮助。

howto.what_en: After you set up your personal profile, Claude acts as a mentor who knows you deeply—responding empathy-first based on your recorded trait tensions, quitting patterns, and effective interventions, and following your custom response rules.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you're struggling, wanting to quit, feeling overwhelmed, etc.

say_en.text: Stuck on this bug for two hours. Part of me wants to quit.
say_en.note: Triggers the skill to respond per your profile.

say_en.text: I'm doubting myself and this project.
say_en.note: Skill responds using your quitting patterns.

say_en.text: I feel overwhelmed and can't do anything right.
say_en.note: Skill acknowledges feelings first, then follows your rules.
